cards.name: Badge
cards.subtitle: Flat status label for state and category — one or two words, sentence case.

cards.name: BandStatement
cards.subtitle: Solid Himalaya with the rosette band on one edge, and a Merino Light statement (no label above it) — the page's one accent (deck slide 3).

cards.name: Breadcrumbs
cards.subtitle: Location trail for deep pages (treatment detail, journal article).

cards.name: Button
cards.subtitle: Shantara's action control — three variants, one near-square shape (`--radius-control`, 2px), taken from the brand deck's closing slide.

cards.name: Dialog
cards.subtitle: Modal for confirmations and short focused tasks. Returns `null` when `open` is false.

cards.name: Divider
cards.subtitle: Hairline separator, optionally with a centred caption label (normal case, muted — never an uppercase eyebrow).

cards.name: FormSplit
cards.subtitle: The consultation form on Merino beside a Stone panel that shows who will call and what happens next.

cards.name: GroupedList
cards.subtitle: Short items gathered under group headings — programmes by focus, therapies by kind.

cards.name: HeroFullBleed
cards.subtitle: Full-screen photographic hero with the statement bottom-left inside a scrim and one Gold primary button (deck slide 1). The **immersive** he

cards.name: HeroSplit
cards.subtitle: The **offer** hero: a photograph on one side, running to the screen edge and the full hero height; the title, meta row, one line, the action

cards.name: HeroStatement
cards.subtitle: The **editorial** hero: words lead, no full photograph (deck slide 2). A large Light h1 placed low on Merino or Stone, closed by a hairline

cards.name: Icon
cards.subtitle: Renders one Lucide glyph, colour-inheriting, for use inside any Shantara control.

cards.name: IconButton
cards.subtitle: Icon-only circular button for toolbars, cards and media overlays.

cards.name: IndexList
cards.subtitle: A text-only index for lists too long for photographs: a group label on the left and hairline rows with a title, one line and an arrow.

cards.name: Input
cards.subtitle: Text field for all single-line entry.

cards.name: LanguageSelector
cards.subtitle: Locale switcher for the public website header and mobile nav. Catalog documentation for this control is English.

cards.name: Logo
cards.subtitle: Places the real Shantara mark. Use this rather than typing the name — the wordmark's tracking and the frangipani mark are fixed brand artwor

cards.name: Media
cards.subtitle: Every photograph on the website — square-cut, cover-fit, lazy by default, with an optional scrim for type on top.

cards.name: MetaRow
cards.subtitle: The caption-size facts row that sits **below** a title — category, duration, date, read time. It replaces the eyebrow: the system has no sma

cards.name: NumberedSteps
cards.subtitle: Numbered steps: muted 01–04 numerals, a Medium item title and one line — the deck's process slide.

cards.name: Numeral
cards.subtitle: One large Light figure (48→84px, tabular) with a small caption.

cards.name: NumeralsSplit
cards.subtitle: A statement beside two or three large Light numerals (deck slide 8).

cards.name: Pagination
cards.subtitle: Previous / numbered pages / next, under the article grid on the Journal index.

cards.name: PanoramaCaption
cards.subtitle: A full-width photograph with a short caption bottom-left and no button — the pause between dense sections (deck slide 5).

cards.name: PatternPanel
cards.subtitle: Rosette **band** on one edge of a surface — the only way the pattern is used. Not a wash behind content, not a texture inside cards. One ban

cards.name: PeopleRow
cards.subtitle: A statement, then two to four doctors in the same 4:5 portrait framing (deck slide 7).

cards.name: PlainList
cards.subtitle: Plain text in columns — no bullets, icons or ticks.

cards.name: PortraitFrame
cards.subtitle: One framing for every doctor: 4:5 on a neutral ground, same crop, then name, role and an optional qualification line.

cards.name: Prose
cards.subtitle: Long-form article text at a 68ch measure. Styles the plain HTML a CMS or Markdown renderer produces — no classes needed in the content.

cards.name: QuoteBlock
cards.subtitle: A large Light quote, left-aligned, closed by an attribution line (short brand rule · speaker in Medium · role) and optional labelled facts o

cards.name: Radio
cards.subtitle: Single choice among a small visible set. Group with a `role="radiogroup"` wrapper and a shared `name`.

cards.name: RelatedArticles
cards.subtitle: A `TileGrid` preset for the end of an article: heading, 2–3 article tiles (title, then "Category · 4 min read" below it), and one link to th

cards.name: ReviewedBy
cards.subtitle: The medical-review strip: who reviewed the article, their role, and when.

cards.name: Section
cards.subtitle: The shell every website section sits in: one ground, the fluid section rhythm and the centred container with a 20→48px gutter.

cards.name: Select
cards.subtitle: Single-choice picker for lists of 6+ options; use `Radio` below that.

cards.name: ShareBar
cards.subtitle: Share an article: **Copy link**, **WhatsApp**, **Email** — outline chips with a core Icon (`link`, `message-circle`, `mail`) and a word.

cards.name: SpecTable
cards.subtitle: Name, figure, attributes — no borders, the accent column in olive (deck slide 13).

cards.name: Spinner
cards.subtitle: Loading state as three dots breathing in sequence — a calm wave, never a rotating ring.

cards.name: SplitSection
cards.subtitle: A photograph running to the edge of the screen on one side and a bottom-aligned text column on the other (deck slides 4, 6 and 13).

cards.name: Statement
cards.subtitle: The deck's heading block: full-sentence headline → optional meta row → one quiet supporting line → actions. **No eyebrow** — nothing small a

cards.name: Switch
cards.subtitle: Immediate-effect toggle. For choices that need a Save press, use `Checkbox`.

cards.name: TableOfContents
cards.subtitle: "On this page" for articles with four or more h2 sections.

cards.name: Tabs
cards.subtitle: Switches between sibling views. The active underline is a 1.5px Himalaya rule — never a filled block.

cards.name: Tag
cards.subtitle: Filter chip or static label. The look is decided by behaviour so a non-interactive tag can never pass for a button.

cards.name: Textarea
cards.subtitle: Long-form entry — guest notes, health intake, journal reflections.

cards.name: TextLink
cards.subtitle: The website's only "more" link — text, hairline underline, arrow, zero inline padding so it sits on the grid.

cards.name: Tile
cards.subtitle: Replaces the white card on linen: photograph and text sit directly on the ground, with no border, shadow or radius. Order: photograph → titl

cards.name: TileGrid
cards.subtitle: A heading row with one text link on the right, then tiles in a grid that never leaves an uneven last row (deck slide 11).

cards.name: TimeTable
cards.subtitle: A time column in olive, then a title and one line (deck slide 15).

cards.name: Toast
cards.subtitle: Short-lived confirmation, Pine Tree by default.

cards.name: Tooltip
cards.subtitle: Wraps a control to explain it in a few words. The text goes in `content` (`label` is an alias).

tokens.name: --shadow-sm
tokens.value: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-pine-tree) 6%, transparent), 0 1px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-pine-tree) 4%, transparent)

tokens.name: --scrim-bottom
tokens.value: linear-gradient(to top, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-pine-tree) 78%, transparent) 0%, transparent 62%)

tokens.name: --scrim-top
tokens.value: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-pine-tree) 55%, transparent) 0%, transparent 55%)

tokens.name: --transition-control
tokens.value: background-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard), color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard), border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard), box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard), transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard)

tokens.name: --transition-fade
tokens.value: opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard), transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out)

tokens.name: --transition-surface
tokens.value: box-shadow var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out), transform var(--duration-base) var(--ease-out)
